description_en: Pays for an order after calling the order creation API
description_zh: 调完仅创单接口，通过此接口进行支付
kebab_example: aliyun linkedmall enable-order --biz-id LMALL201912040001 --biz-uid example-string --out-trade-id example-string --lm-order-id example-string --ext-json example-string --use-anonymous-tb-account true --third-party-user-id example-string --account-type ANONY --api-version 2018-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableOrder

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the business. This value is provided by Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh: 业务的唯一标识号，由阿里云提供
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to the same value as ThirdPartyUserId
parameters.name: biz_uid

parameters.help_en: The unique order ID on the customer side. If this parameter is not specified, Alibaba Cloud generates one
parameters.help_zh: 客户唯一订单号，未提供时，由阿里云创建
parameters.name: out_trade_id

parameters.help_en: The external primary order ID returned when the order was created
parameters.help_zh: 创建订单时的外放主订单id
parameters.name: lm_order_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID on the customer side
parameters.name: third_party_user_id

parameters.help_en: The account type. Set this parameter to ANONY
parameters.name: account_type
